workflows.title: Set appointment calendar title
workflows.description: When an appointment is created or its customer/technician changes, writes "Customer – Technician" to calendarTitle (display only, written directly so schedule checks are not re-run).

nodes.title: Write customer – technician to calendar title

config.sql: UPDATE "appointments" AS a SET "calendarTitle" = COALESCE(c."firstName", '?') || ' – ' || COALESCE(s."firstName", 'Unassigned') FROM "appointments" AS a2 LEFT JOIN "customers" AS c ON c."id" = a2."customerId" LEFT JOIN "staff" AS s ON s."id" = a2."staffId" WHERE a."id" = a2."id" AND a."id" = {{$context.data.id}}

workflows.title: Set appointment calendar title copy
workflows.description: When an appointment is created or its customer/technician changes, writes "Customer – Technician" to calendarTitle (display only, written directly so schedule checks are not re-run).

nodes.title: Write customer – technician to calendar title

config.sql: UPDATE "appointments" AS a SET "calendarTitle" = t.title FROM (SELECT a2."id", COALESCE(c."firstName", '?') || ' – ' || COALESCE(s."firstName", 'Unassigned') AS title FROM "appointments" AS a2 LEFT JOIN "customers" AS c ON c."id" = a2."customerId" LEFT JOIN "staff" AS s ON s."id" = a2."staffId") AS t WHERE a."id" = t."id" AND a."calendarTitle" IS DISTINCT FROM t.title

workflows.title: Process appointment reminders
workflows.description: Runs every 15 minutes. Finds pending appointment reminders that are due (scheduledFor <= now) and sends email reminders through the customerMessages delivery pipeline. Created by yarn apply:appointment-reminders.

config.sql:
SELECT
      r.id                    AS "reminderId",
      r."appointmentId",
      r."customerId",
      r."intervalKey",
      r."scheduledFor",
      a."startTime"           AS "appointmentStartTime",
      a.status                AS "appointmentStatus",
      c."firstName",
      c."lastName",
      c.email                 AS "customerEmail"
    FROM "appointmentReminders" r
    JOIN appointments a ON a.id = r."appointmentId"
    JOIN customers    c ON c.id = r."customerId"
    WHERE r.status = 'pending'
      AND r."scheduledFor" <= NOW()
      AND a.status IN ('scheduled', 'confirmed')
      AND c.email IS NOT NULL
      AND c.email <> ''
    ORDER BY r."scheduledFor" ASC
    LIMIT 100;

UPDATE "appointmentReminders"
SET status    = 'sent',
    "sentAt"  = NOW(),
    "updatedAt" = NOW()
WHERE status = 'pending'
  AND "scheduledFor" <= NOW()
  AND "appointmentId" IN (
    SELECT a.id FROM appointments a WHERE a.status IN ('scheduled', 'confirmed')
  )
  AND "customerId" IN (
    SELECT c.id FROM customers c WHERE c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email <> ''
  );

WITH settings AS ( SELECT COALESCE("emailSubject", 'Reminder: Your appointment is coming up!') AS tpl_subject, COALESCE("emailBody", '

Hi {{firstName}},

This is a friendly reminder that you have an appointment with {{staffName}} at {{appointmentTime}} on {{appointmentDate}}.

If you need to reschedule, please contact us as soon as possible.

We look forward to seeing you!

') AS tpl_body FROM "appointmentReminderSettings" ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 ), due AS ( SELECT r.id AS reminder_id, r."customerId", c."firstName", c."lastName", c.email, a."startTime", COALESCE(st."firstName", 'your stylist') AS staff_name, TO_CHAR(a."startTime" AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago', 'FMDay, FMMonth FMDD, YYYY') AS appt_date, TO_CHAR(a."startTime" AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago', 'FMHH12:MI AM') AS appt_time FROM "appointmentReminders" r JOIN appointments a ON a.id = r."appointmentId" JOIN customers c ON c.id = r."customerId" LEFT JOIN staff st ON st.id = a."staffId" WHERE r.status = 'pending' AND r."scheduledFor" <= NOW() AND a.status IN ('scheduled', 'confirmed') AND c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email <> '' ORDER BY r."scheduledFor" ASC LIMIT 100 ) INSERT INTO "customerMessages" (channel, recipient, subject, body, "bodyHtml", status, "customerId", "createdAt", "updatedAt") SELECT 'email', d.email, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(s.tpl_subject, '{{firstName}}', COALESCE(d."firstName",'')), '{{lastName}}', COALESCE(d."lastName",'')), '{{staffName}}', d.staff_name), '{{appointmentDate}}', d.appt_date), '{{appointmentTime}}', d.appt_time), REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(s.tpl_body, '{{firstName}}', COALESCE(d."firstName",'')), '{{lastName}}', COALESCE(d."lastName",'')), '{{staffName}}', d.staff_name), '{{appointmentDate}}', d.appt_date), '{{appointmentTime}}', d.appt_time), '
' || REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(s.tpl_body, '{{firstName}}', COALESCE(d."firstName",'')), '{{lastName}}', COALESCE(d."lastName",'')), '{{staffName}}', d.staff_name), '{{appointmentDate}}', d.appt_date), '{{appointmentTime}}', d.appt_time) || '
', 'queued', d."customerId", NOW(), NOW() FROM due d, settings s;
